properties.name:
Kosvinsky Kamen
 Complex (Strategic Missile Forces Alternate Command Post)
properties.description:
It is understood that there's a massive underground facility housing a strategic command post.

According to one recent account ["We Keep Building Nukes For All the Wrong Reasons", By Bruce G. Blair, The Washington Post Sunday, May 25, 2003; Page B01] "Kosvinsky is regarded by U.S. targeteers as the crown jewel of the Russian wartime nuclear command system, because it can communicate through the granite mountain to far-flung Russian strategic forces using very-low-frequency (VLF) radio signals that can burn through a nuclear war environment. The facility is the critical link to Russia's "dead hand" communications network, designed to ensure semi-automatic retaliation to a decapitating strike. (https://www.globalsecurity.org/wmd/world/russia/kosvinsky.htm)

properties.name: Training Center for Special Department of the FSB No. 100 of the EMERCOM - Moscow
properties.description:
A special object of the Ministry of Emergencies of the Russian Federation, a former laboratory of measurements and tests of the Moscow Metro. According to rumors, a special metro line "D-6" (the so-called metro-2) ends here and from here the left tributary of the Ochakovka river is powered along the collectors. Excluded from the territory of the September "Landscape Reserve" Troparevsky "" by the Decree of the Government of Moscow N 1164-PP of December 23, 2008 (mosopen.ru/document/1164_pp_2008-12-23)

Excursions in underground Moscow. For the novice Negla, Stalin's bunker, Grandteplukha. Ramenki, D6 - by agreement. A tour of the UNK in Protvino. 20 kilometers of tunels! Applications write to v.gonik@diggspas.org vadmix@diggspas.org
